outcome: A webhook delivery that fails transiently is retried without overwhelming the endpoint.

acceptance_criteria.text: A delivery that succeeds is reported as delivered.
Retries after a server error are spaced rather than sent immediately one after another.

expected_verification.assertion: three attempts against a 5xx endpoint are separated in time

security_impact: An unspaced retry burst against a third-party endpoint is a denial-of-service the product's own address is attached to.
